name: Is a Comparative Market Analysis the same as a home appraisal?

mainEntity.name: Is a Comparative Market Analysis the same as a home appraisal?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, a Comparative Market Analysis (CMA) is not the same as a home appraisal, though both provide a property valuation. A CMA is typically performed by a real estate agent to help set a listing price, reflecting current market conditions and recent sales. An appraisal, on the other hand, is conducted by a licensed appraiser for lenders and is a more formal, legally recognized valuation often required for mortgage approval. Kelby Contreras provides CMAs as a service to clients, distinct from formal appraisals.
acceptedAnswer.description: A CMA helps set a listing price and is done by an agent; an appraisal is a formal valuation by a licensed appraiser for lenders.
